text:
### Observed differences

- Participation: before, A22, A31, A32 and A37 each ran in every one of the 200 earlier traces, exactly once per trace; in the later window A22 runs in about 54 in 100 traces (107 of 200) and each of A31, A32 and A37 in about 47 in 100 (94 of 200), still at most once per trace. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004]
- Exclusivity: A22 and the trio A31/A32/A37, which co-occurred in all earlier traces, now share a trace in only about 1 in 200 cases; about 53 in 100 later traces contain A22 but not the trio, about 47 in 100 contain the trio but not A22, and no trace contains neither — one of the two is now skipped in every trace. The trio itself still runs jointly (its co-occurrence of about 47 in 100 matches its participation) and keeps no fixed internal order in either window (about 52/48 before, 46/54 after). [REL011, REL012, REL013, REL020, REL021, REL022]
- The A22 branch is otherwise unchanged: in the later window, as before, A20, A23 and A21 precede A22, and A22 precedes A26, in essentially every trace containing A22. [REL001, REL005, REL009, REL010]
- Placement of the trio: before, A31/A32/A37 ran between A20 and A23 — A20 reached A23 exactly 4 positions later in all 200 traces, with the trio 1–3 positions after A20, and the trio preceded A21 and A23 in 100% of traces. In the later window A21 and A23 precede the trio in about 99 in 100 of the traces containing both (the old order survives in about 1 in 200), while the trio's order relative to A20 (before it) and A26 (after it) is unchanged. [REL006, REL007, REL008, REL014, REL015, REL016, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL017, REL018, REL019]
- Distances: A23 now directly follows A20 (1 position later in 199 of 200 later traces, against a fixed gap of 4 positions in all earlier traces), and A21 reaches A26 2 positions later in the ~54% of traces with A22 but 4 positions later in the ~46% with the trio, against a fixed gap of 2 before. The ordered pairs A20→A31/A32/A37 and A31/A32/A37→A23 within five steps, present in all 200 earlier traces, each survive in only 1 later trace. [LAG001, LAG005, LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008]
- Mean relative event positions shifted earlier for A23 (about 0.45→0.39), A21 (0.60→0.54) and A22 (0.63→0.59), and later for the trio (about 0.39–0.40→0.57–0.58). [POS004, POS002, POS003, POS006, POS007, POS008]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports one coherent structural hypothesis: in the later window the block A31/A32/A37 runs in the stretch between A21 and A26, where it alternates almost perfectly with A22 — each trace executes one of the two but almost never both (A22 in about 54 in 100 traces, the trio in about 47 in 100) — whereas before, the trio always ran between A20 and A23 and A22 always ran between A21 and A26. The surrounding sequence (A20, then A23, then A21, then A26) and the internal make-up of the A22 branch are otherwise preserved. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, REL011, REL012, REL013, LAG001, LAG005, REL006, REL014, REL017]

The placement component is shown directly by relational and distance evidence: the order between the trio and A21/A23 flips while its order to A20 and A26 stays fixed, the A20→A23 gap collapses from 4 positions to 1, and the A21→A26 gap splits into 2 (A22 traces) versus 4 (trio traces). The participation component is shown by the drops from 100% to about 54% and 47% with near-perfect mutual exclusivity (co-occurrence about 1 in 200, no trace with neither). Screening tested 74 control-flow units and 42 items qualified, where about 0.37 would be expected by chance in an unchanged process, and every item's difference exceeds about 995 of 1000 random re-splits, so the ensemble far exceeds what random re-splits of a stable process produce. [LAG001, LAG005, REL006, REL014, REL002, REL017, OCC001, OCC002, REL011]

Limitations: the specific after-window gap values for the relocated pairs rest on a single observation each, so only their near-disappearance (from 200 traces to 1) is usable, not the new gap sizes; and the evidence cannot distinguish one process with a new exclusive choice between A22 and the trio from a later window that mixes two trace variants. [LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008, REL011]

Other differences: minor drifts in mean relative position for A20 (about 0.34→0.36) and A26 (about 0.66→0.63), consistent with shorter average traces once only one branch runs; not treated as separate changes. [POS001, POS005]
